subtitle.message: For the best experience, please pin the SafeClick extension to your toolbar.

step1.message: Click the puzzle icon (Extensions) in the Chrome toolbar.

step3.message: Click the pin icon to keep SafeClick visible.

statusPinned.message: Great! SafeClick is pinned to your toolbar.

statusNotPinned.message: Not pinned yet. Please open the Extensions (puzzle) menu and click the pin next to SafeClick.

statusError.message: Error contacting extension. Please try again.
